title: [finding] client auth-get-session-envelope.test.ts pays the engine cold start inside its first clocked test and timed out at 5000ms on a required Test Core shard — the sibling #20272 fixed for auth-login-register
body:
Filing gate: **① a flake on the shared merge path, observed in CI.** A required context (`Test Core (5/6)`) went red on a PR that does not touch the package.
- `reach:` observed. PR #20325 (head `e9f93902`, which does not touch `packages/client`), job `108717176436`, run `36353694714`, 2026-09-27T22:12Z:
  - `@objectstack/client:test`: `Tests 1 failed | 636 passed (637)`;
  - `src/auth-get-session-envelope.test.ts > [#16760] /get-session is lifted into the SessionResponse envelope it declares > ① me() delivers the envelope it declares > parses as the declared envelope, with the payload under data` at line 262: **`Error: Test timed out in 5000ms`**.
  - `main`'s CI at `de091b50` was green.
- **Mechanism, read by this seat on `main`:** the file's first test calls `await signedIn()` INSIDE the clocked `it` (`:262`–`:264`), so the engine's cold start is paid within a 5-second test timeout. This is exactly the shape PR #20272 (`80c29a14`) removed from the sibling `auth-login-register-envelope.test.ts`: `await registered(); await closeEngines();` at module scope, plus a pin (⑦) that the cold start stays outside every clocked window. #20272 did not cover this file.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`, seat post #6017), per 「谁发现 flake 谁修或立单」. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. The file lands in `packages/client`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the fix is (for the dispatch to confirm)

- Port #20272's pattern: pay the first `signedIn()` (engine cold start) once at module scope, close it, and keep `afterEach` closing per case.
- Add the same kind of pin, so the cold start cannot drift back into a clocked window.
- Census the other `packages/client/src/auth-*envelope*.test.ts` files (and any suite that boots an engine inside its first `it`) for the same shape, and fix the family in one PR.
- ⛔ No raised timeout or retry as the fix: #20272's reasoning applies.

## Dedupe

A local scan of every open and recently closed objectstack issue and PR for `auth-get-session-envelope|get-session…(timed out|timeout|flak)|auth-envelope suite` finds 1 hit: PR #20272 (the sibling file, merged). None carries this file.
